about: The command-line tool for reading, filtering and reshaping JSON.

prs.title: Dates without a day land on the 1st, not the month before
prs.broken: Reading a date like 2024-06 with no day left the day at zero, which counts as the last day of the month before, so 2024-06 became May 31.
prs.changed: The day now starts at 1, as in Python and gojq. A weekday bug for early 1900 and 2100 was fixed too, checked against the system clock for every day across two centuries.
prs.matters: Month-only and year-only dates convert to the date people expect.
